$comment: Time-boxed exceptions for scripts/audit-dependencies.mjs --enforce. Each entry needs a one-line justification and an `expires` date at most 60 days after `added`; the gate fails once an entry expires or is no longer reported. See qa/VERIFICATION.md.

entries.justification: Improper SVG escaping in satori's image generation (moderate); Bocal never calls vinext's OG image route or satori, the chain is build-time only, and the patched vinext 1.3.1 requires React 19.3, a framework upgrade that does not belong in a dependency-patch change.
